title: documents.php request body
description: Multipart or form-encoded POST body accepted by public/documents.php. upload also carries one multipart file part named `file` (a PDF of at most 20 MB); the file is outside this schema because JSON Schema cannot describe a multipart part, and DocumentRequest::fromBag refuses upload without it (400). The patient id is taken from the OpenEMR session only. ACL: list needs patients/docs view; upload and extract need patients/docs write or addonly (403 otherwise). Missing or wrong CSRF token: 403.

csrf_token_form.description: OpenEMR CSRF token for the session, as embedded in the panel markup.

action.description: list: the patient's Co-Pilot documents with status. upload: store a PDF (deduplicated per patient by sha3-512; 200 with existing=true when the same file was already stored, else 201). extract: run the sidecar on a stored document and persist the cited facts.

document_id.description: extract only. The OpenEMR document id returned by upload or list, as a decimal string.

doc_type.description: upload only. What the PDF is; decides the extraction contract (lab-report or intake-form).

oneOf.description: upload needs the doc_type (and the multipart file).
